title: Cover Foundation Wall Exterior | Before & After Stone Upgrade
description: Looking for a way to cover a concrete foundation wall? See how this project transformed a large exterior surface with stone. Real before and after.
text:
How to Cover a Concrete Foundation Wall on the Exterior
See how this homeowner transformed a large concrete foundation into a finished, high-end exterior feature—without rebuilding.

Kenneth Stauffer

Senior Project Coordinator / Training Supervisor

Hi, I’m Kenneth, and I worked with this homeowner on improving a large exposed foundation area that was taking away from the home’s overall appearance.

The upper portion of the home looked clean and modern, but the lower section—bare concrete block—felt unfinished and out of place.

The homeowner didn’t want to rebuild or re-side the entire home. They just needed a way to cover the foundation and make it look intentional.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

Covering a Foundation Wall Without Rebuilding It
Update a Concrete Block Wall • Installs Over Concrete Block

Instead of removing or replacing the concrete, we installed stone veneer directly over the surface—turning a plain foundation into a finished architectural feature.

✅ Installed directly over concrete block

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

From Exposed Concrete to a Finished Exterior
A simple upgrade turned this builder-grade exterior into a clean, custom look adding depth, contrast, and a high-end finish without major construction.

Before

The Goal

- Exposed concrete foundation

- Large unfinished surface

- Didn’t match the rest of the home

- Reduced curb appeal

- Looked incomplete

After

The Solution

- Cover foundation with stone veneer

- Create a consistent, finished look

- Add texture and contrast

- Match upper exterior style

- Turn a problem area into a feature

What Does It Cost to Cover a Foundation Wall Like This?

Projects like this typically range between $4,000–$12,000, depending on size and layout. This is often far more cost-effective than replacing siding or reworking the entire exterior structure.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners, Ledgers

- Color: Northern Slate

- Install: Over Concrete Block

Can This Be Installed Over Concrete Block?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface. To install over block, simply use Tapcon screws and construction adhesive.

Will This Hold Up on a Foundation Wall?

Yes, GenStone is engineered to withstand the elements and perform like any other siding product. GenStone will actually add extra R-Value to your concrete wall as well.

Is This Better Than Parge or Paint?

Yes, with parge or paint you will be left with a flat concrete like surface whereas with GenStone, you will not only add color, but also texture and depth.

Northern Slate Color Guide

This color was chosen to create contrast against the darker siding while giving the foundation a natural, finished stone appearance.
